ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportSchematyNumeracji' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportSchematyNumeracji;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportSchematyNumeracji] @rowVersion bigint, @pointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @dbts bigint = cast(@@DBTS as bigint)
declare @dokumenty table(typ int) insert into @dokumenty values (2033),(8960),(2034)
declare @picoId int, @centum int,@pckTyp int select @pckTyp=pck_typ,@picoId = pck_picoid,@centum=PcK_CentrumID from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.PicoStanowiska on psa_pckid = pck_picoid where psa_id=@pointOfSaleId
select @rowVersion as [@RowVersion], ( select * from( select dok.dok_Id as [@Id], dok.Dok_Nazwa as [@Name], dok.dok_Symbol as [@DocumentSymbol], '' as [@UnconfirmedDocumentPrefix], 1 as [@StartNumber], 1 as [@DigitsCount], case when kon_wartosc like '%7%' THEN 'true' when kon_wartosc like '%6%' then 'false' else null end as [@TwoDigitMonth], ( select * from ( select dok.dok_Id*10 as [@Id], 1 as [@OrdinalNumber], '' as [@Separator], 'DocumentSymbol' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber]
union all
select dok.dok_Id*10 + Row_Number() over(PARTITION BY kon_numer ORDER BY kon_numer) as [@Id], Row_Number() over(PARTITION BY kon_numer ORDER BY kon_numer)+1 as [@OrdinalNumber], case when Row_Number() over(PARTITION BY kon_numer ORDER BY kon_numer) = 1 then '-' else u.separator end as [@Separator], u.val as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] from ( select wew.kon_numer,'/' as separator, case when len(Kon_Wartosc) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,1,1) = '1' THEN 'Number' --(N) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,1,1) = '2' THEN 'Number' --(NN) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,1,1) = '3' THEN 'Year2' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,1,1) = '4' THEN 'Year4' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,1,1) = '5' THEN 'Series' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,1,1) = '6' THEN 'Month' --(M) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,1,1) = '7' THEN 'Month' --(MM) ELSE '' END ELSE '' END as FC1, case when len(Kon_Wartosc) > 2 THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,3,1) = '1' THEN 'Number' --(N) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,3,1) = '2' THEN 'Number' --(NN) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,3,1) = '3' THEN 'Year2' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,3,1) = '4' THEN 'Year4' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,3,1) = '5' THEN 'Series' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,3,1) = '6' THEN 'Month' --(M) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,3,1) = '7' THEN 'Month' --(MM) ELSE '' END ELSE '' END as FC2, case when len(Kon_Wartosc) > 4 THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,5,1) = '1' THEN 'Number' --(N) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,5,1) = '2' THEN 'Number' --(NN) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,5,1) = '3' THEN 'Year2' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,5,1) = '4' THEN 'Year4' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,5,1) = '5' THEN 'Series' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,5,1) = '6' THEN 'Month' --(M) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,5,1) = '7' THEN 'Month' --(MM) ELSE '' END ELSE '' END as FC3, case when len(Kon_Wartosc) > 6 THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,7,1) = '1' THEN 'Number' --(N) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,7,1) = '2' THEN 'Number' --(NN) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,7,1) = '3' THEN 'Year2' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,7,1) = '4' THEN 'Year4' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,7,1) = '5' THEN 'Series' WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,7,1) = '6' THEN 'Month' --(M) WHEN SUBSTRING(wew.kon_wartosc,7,1) = '7' THEN 'Month' --(MM) ELSE '' END ELSE '' END as FC4 from cdn.konfig wew where wew.Kon_Numer = zew.kon_numer ) s unpivot ( val for FC in (FC1, FC2, FC3, FC4) ) u ) a where [@FunctionCode] <> '' for xml path('Element'), type ) [Elements] from cdn.konfig zew cross apply (select * from cdn.DokDefinicje org where dok_gidtyp in(select * from @dokumenty) AND dok_FrsId = @centum) dok where Kon_Komentarz like '%Format numeracji%' and Kon_Numer = 992 --AND (dok.dok_WystPrawo = 1 OR dok.Dok_GIDTyp = 8960)
union all
select 1 as [@Id], 'Wpłata kasowo-bankowa' as [@Name], 'KP' as [@DocumentSymbol], '' as [@UnconfirmedDocumentPrefix], 1 as [@StartNumber], 1 as [@DigitsCount], null as [@TwoDigitMonth], ( select * from( select 10 as [@Id], 1 as [@OrdinalNumber], '' as [@Separator], 'DocumentSymbol' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] union all select 11 as [@Id], 2 as [@OrdinalNumber], '/' as [@Separator], 'Number' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] union all select 12 as [@Id], 3 as [@OrdinalNumber], '/' as [@Separator], 'Year2' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] ) c for xml path('Element'), type ) [Elements]
union all
select 2 as [@Id], 'Wypłata kasowo-bankowa' as [@Name], 'KW' as [@DocumentSymbol], '' as [@UnconfirmedDocumentPrefix], 1 as [@StartNumber], 1 as [@DigitsCount], null as [@TwoDigitMonth], ( select * from( select 20 as [@Id], 1 as [@OrdinalNumber], '' as [@Separator], 'DocumentSymbol' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] union all select 21 as [@Id], 2 as [@OrdinalNumber], '/' as [@Separator], 'Number' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] union all select 22 as [@Id], 3 as [@OrdinalNumber], '/' as [@Separator], 'Year2' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] ) c for xml path('Element'), type ) [Elements]
union all
select 3 as [@Id], 'Nota debetowa' as [@Name], 'ND' as [@DocumentSymbol], '' as [@UnconfirmedDocumentPrefix], 1 as [@StartNumber], 1 as [@DigitsCount], null as [@TwoDigitMonth], ( select * from( select 30 as [@Id], 1 as [@OrdinalNumber], '' as [@Separator], 'DocumentSymbol' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] union all select 31 as [@Id], 2 as [@OrdinalNumber], '/' as [@Separator], 'Number' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] union all select 32 as [@Id], 3 as [@OrdinalNumber], '/' as [@Separator], 'Year2' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] ) c for xml path('Element'), type ) [Elements]
union all
select 4 as [@Id], 'Podsumowanie sesji' as [@Name], 'PS' as [@DocumentSymbol], '' as [@UnconfirmedDocumentPrefix], 1 as [@StartNumber], 1 as [@DigitsCount], null as [@TwoDigitMonth], ( select * from( select 40 as [@Id], 1 as [@OrdinalNumber], '' as [@Separator], 'DocumentSymbol' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] union all select 41 as [@Id], 2 as [@OrdinalNumber], '/' as [@Separator], 'Number' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] union all select 42 as [@Id], 3 as [@OrdinalNumber], '/' as [@Separator], 'Year2' as [@FunctionCode], 'true' as [@AffectsNumber] ) c for xml path('Element'), type ) [Elements] ) a for xml path('NumeratorScheme'), type) for xml path('NumeratorSchemes') SET NOCOUNT OFF;
END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportSchematyNumeracji TO CDNRaport
